title: HSK1 Gate 12 · Tang Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 12: Tang Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第12关：唐朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 唐朝的时候，中国很大也很有名。唐朝的大城叫长安。那时候，长安是世界上最大的城。城里有很多路，路很直很长。
passageEn: In the Tang dynasty China was large and well known. The great city of the Tang was called Chang’an. At that time Chang’an was the largest city in the world. The city had many streets, straight and long.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Tang dynasty China was large and well known.
comprehension.answer: 唐朝的时候，中国很大也很有名。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: At that time Chang’an was the largest city in the world.
comprehension.answer: 那时候，长安是世界上最大的城。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Tang Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说唐朝。
